text: Something breaks, and the easy answer is to replace it. FixOdds gives you the odds before you decide.
Pick the item and the symptoms. You can also describe it in your own words. Nothing you type leaves your device.

The odds come from more than four hundred thousand real repair attempts, logged by repair cafes around the world. On repairs held back from training, the top band was fixed or repairable nearly nine times in ten. The lowest band, about six in ten.

Here, a successful repair avoids about one hundred and thirty kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent, and keeps nearly two kilograms of electronics in use. The factors come from The Restart Project, halved, because not every repair replaces a purchase.
It shows what usually stops this repair, what to do about it, and the nearest of twenty thousand mapped repair places, worked out on your own device.
Take a repair ticket with you, log the outcome, and export it in the Open Repair Data Standard, so a repair group can share it.
The method page shows the working, including why free text is left out: repair notes reveal the outcome. FixOdds. Give repair a fair chance.
